criteria.finding: Project source generation is a positive canonical PostgreSQL bigint rendered as decimal text; real changes increment, no-op saves retain it, changes at int64 ceiling fail before protected mutation, and requests reject client-supplied generation fields.

Plan creation holds project and scoped release locks, validates current retained source match and captures current server generation in a separate nullable plan field; format-1 intent digest inputs remain unchanged.

APPROVE holds plan, project, scoped release locks; checks plan/current generations and retained source match before writes. Two real PostgreSQL blocking tests serialize concurrent binding update with approval and creation. Fixed denial is no-write; existing archive/role/terminal/self precedence and denial audits are preserved.

Idempotent legacy-schema initialization creates only a current project generation and leaves plan generation NULL. Full plan/release/comment/history/audit snapshots survive initialization and PostgreSQL/API pool restart; old plans remain readable and rejectable while approval requires fresh plan.

Review UI disables known stale/missing/corrupt approvals, keeps rejection available, handles authoritative stale-server denial without leaking to changed plan selection, and reuses T18 read-only fresh-plan navigation. Real browser test verifies no write on navigation, clears drafts/inspected source and All filter, creates distinct current-generation release/plan, approves independently and preserves predecessor snapshot.

Frozen regressions use real temporary Git, PostgreSQL, parser/API and Chromium. Focused API 3/3 and browser 1/1 independently rerun; full standard/product/browser reported 149/28/17 with zero failures/skips. Existing cross-project/organization, role/session, archive and T18 workflows are included by preserved suite regressions.

limits: The generation is an application/database epoch and does not claim protection against privileged database tampering.
A bigint column cannot store malformed nonnumeric text; missing, zero, negative, noncanonical API input, mismatched and stale evidence are rejected.
No runner/worker execution-time invalidation, runtime target verification, Oracle execution or full-catalog acceptance is claimed. Sonar remains unavailable and is not PASS.
pre_freeze_correction: A browser plan-selection ReferenceError was discovered during evolving-source review and fixed before this frozen commit; focused and full browser checks now pass.
prior_failures: Earlier native failed attempts remain captured in the immutable native evidence directory; they are not counted as final passing runs.
